body.p:
Sometimes after creating a project, certain information needs to be edited. The steps are similar to those for creating a new project:
Open the main DITA map in the DITA Maps Manager.
Right-click the map and select Translate (Fluenta) Edit project "{ProjectName}" .This action is visible only if there is a Fluenta project associated with the current DITA map and this project will be edited.
In the resulting dialog box, you need to replace the project information you want updated and click OK when finished.
